scenarios.title: A｜提醒洗碗 / 打扫
scenarios.setting: 厨房水槽里已经堆了两天的碗。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Hey, could you wash the dishes when you get a chance?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, could you wash the dishes when you get a chance?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Would you mind doing the dishes tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you mind doing the dishes tonight?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Hey, I think those dishes have been in the sink for a couple of days.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, I think those dishes have been in the sink for a couple of days.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Could you clean up the kitchen after you’re done eating?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you clean up the kitchen after you’re done eating?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Can you clean the dishes?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, could you wash the dishes when you get a chance?
feedback.explanation: 能理解，但洗碗通常说 do/wash the dishes

turns.text: Oh, yeah. Sorry. I was going to do them yesterday.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: No worries. I just need to use the sink later.

feedback.naturalExpression: No worries. I just need to use the sink later.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: That’s fine. Could you just take care of them tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. Could you just take care of them tonight?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Thanks. And could you wipe down the counter too?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. And could you wipe down the counter too?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Sure. I’ll do it after dinner.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Thanks, I appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks, I appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Great, thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: B｜协商家务分工
scenarios.setting: 类似的问题已经发生很多次，玩家决定和室友商量固定的家务安排。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Can we talk about how we’re dividing up the chores?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can we talk about how we’re dividing up the chores?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I think we should figure out a better way to split the housework.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we should figure out a better way to split the housework.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Would you be open to making some kind of cleaning schedule?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you be open to making some kind of cleaning schedule?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I feel like the chores have been a little uneven lately. Can we work something out?

feedback.naturalExpression: I feel like the chores have been a little uneven lately. Can we work something out?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: We need to divide the houseworks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Can we talk about how we’re dividing up the chores?
feedback.explanation: housework 通常不可数；也可以说 split the chores

turns.text: Sure. What did you have in mind?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Maybe we could take turns cleaning the kitchen and bathroom.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we could take turns cleaning the kitchen and bathroom.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: How about I do the bathroom this week and you do the kitchen?

feedback.naturalExpression: How about I do the bathroom this week and you do the kitchen?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: We could each be responsible for our own dishes and alternate the shared areas.

feedback.naturalExpression: We could each be responsible for our own dishes and alternate the shared areas.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Maybe we could make a simple weekly schedule so we both know what needs to be done.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we could make a simple weekly schedule so we both know what needs to be done.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I hate cleaning the bathroom. Could I do the kitchen instead?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Sure. Then I can handle the bathroom if you take care of the kitchen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Then I can handle the bathroom if you take care of the kitchen.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: That’s fine with me. Maybe we can split the other chores evenly.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine with me. Maybe we can split the other chores evenly.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay. As long as we’re both doing roughly the same amount overall.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. As long as we’re both doing roughly the same amount overall.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Great. Let’s try that for a couple of weeks and see how it goes.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Let’s try that for a couple of weeks and see how it goes.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Perfect. That should make things easier.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. That should make things easier.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: C｜对方不愿配合
scenarios.setting: 在“室友不做家务”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“对方不愿配合”。

turns.text: Honestly, I don’t see why we need a schedule. I clean when things look dirty.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: The problem is that I’m usually the one cleaning them before you do.

feedback.naturalExpression: The problem is that I’m usually the one cleaning them before you do.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t need a strict schedule, but I do need you to contribute regularly.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t need a strict schedule, but I do need you to contribute regularly.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not asking you to clean everything. I’m asking us to share the responsibility.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not asking you to clean everything. I’m asking us to share the responsibility.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: We both live here, so I don’t think the cleaning should fall mostly on one person.

feedback.naturalExpression: We both live here, so I don’t think the cleaning should fall mostly on one person.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I think you’re just more particular about cleanliness than I am.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Maybe, but leaving dirty dishes for several days affects both of us.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe, but leaving dirty dishes for several days affects both of us.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: We don’t have to have exactly the same standards, but we need to agree on a basic level of cleanliness.

feedback.naturalExpression: We don’t have to have exactly the same standards, but we need to agree on a basic level of cleanliness.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m willing to compromise, but I can’t keep doing most of the housework myself.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m willing to compromise, but I can’t keep doing most of the housework myself.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: This isn’t about everything being perfect. It’s about keeping the shared spaces usable.

feedback.naturalExpression: This isn’t about everything being perfect. It’s about keeping the shared spaces usable.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I don’t want to spend my free time cleaning all the time.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Neither do I. That’s why I want us to split it fairly.

feedback.naturalExpression: Neither do I. That’s why I want us to split it fairly.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not asking for constant cleaning. I’m asking for a reasonable share.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not asking for constant cleaning. I’m asking for a reasonable share.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Then let’s agree on the minimum we both need to do.

feedback.naturalExpression: Then let’s agree on the minimum we both need to do.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。
